summary: A generative Berlin School firmware, forked from DUB-1, that plays long, self-running pieces of repeating sequences, drones and echo in the style of 1970s German electronic music.
features: Two drifting sequences, a drone, a gliding lead and an atmosphere layer
Ten built-in pieces, each with its own key, tempo and sounds
White keys play the lead in key; it answers phrases you play
Black keys trigger eleven held performance effects
Mute and solo layers; filters move independently on their own clocks
Pieces repeat indefinitely and never end on their own
